QuestInfo.name: Help Hunt the Snails
QuestInfo.0: #bSam#k in the Dangerous Forest is waiting for you to help him.
QuestInfo.1: Sam wants you to take care of some snails. Slay #r10 Snails#k, then tell #bLucas#k that the field is clear.\n\nSnail #r#a10371##k
QuestInfo.2: You told #bLucas#k that you took care of the snails.

0.0: 흐음... 마리아는 잘 하고 있을까...? 아, 여행자님. 안녕하세요? 지금 혹시 달팽이사냥터를 가로질러 동쪽으로 가고 계신가요? 그렇다면 부탁 하나만 들어주시지 않겠어요?

yes.0: 암허스트에 사는 마리아가 버섯을 따러 이 근처로 오기로 했는데 통 오질 않네요. 아무래도 달팽이들이 무서워서 움직이지 못하는 것 같아요.
yes.1: 그러니 당신께서 가는 길에 달팽이 10마리만 퇴치해 주시면 안 될까요? 달팽이를 퇴치한 후 마리아에게 걱정하지 말고 움직이라는 말까지 전해 주시면 감사하겠습니다.

0.0: I wonder where Maria is... Oh, hello traveler! Are you, by any chance, heading east? If so, can you do me a favor?

yes.0: Lucas, who lives in Amherst, asked me to get rid of the snails to protect his neighbors. I have a hunch it's because of their fear of #rSnails#k.
yes.1: Could you please hunt #r10 Snails#k, so the village is safe from them? Afterwards, please notify #bLucas#k and let him know it's safe.
yes.2: You can reach Amherst by traveling east. Also, you can check the World Map by pressing the #bW key#k.

no.0: Hmmm... But think of other people in fear!

1.0: You're new here, aren't you? What can I do for you?

yes.0: Oh, did you eliminate some Snails? Well, that is just so nice of you! Now we can all pick mushrooms in peace.
yes.1: I think you deserve something nice for helping us out! Don't try to be modest...It's my turn to help you. You've got that look that says you want to be strong, am I right? Well, I can #bintroduce you to a trainer#k that will pump you right up! That's right, so come talk to me when you're ready.

npc.0: Hmmm... Defeat #r10 Snails#k, then keep heading right until you see Lucas.

mob.0: Hmmm? Are you here on Sam's behalf? Then please hunt #r10 Snails#k first then talk to me.
